rics.description: Actual use of foreign investment, FDI, computer, communications & other electronic equipment
rics.meaning: China FDI: Actual use of foreign investment, FDI, computer, communications & other electronic equipment. Foreign direct investment data by source country, sector, or industry.
rics.how_to_use: FDI inflows weakened sharply 2022-2024 amid US-China decoupling, regulatory crackdowns (tech, education, gaming), and slowing growth. Watch sectoral mix — services FDI relatively resilient, manufacturing FDI declining. Major sources: Hong Kong (#1, often pass-through), Singapore, Japan, South Korea.

rics.description: International investment asset position, direct investment, associated corporate debt
rics.meaning: China International Investment Position: International investment asset position, direct investment, associated corporate debt. SAFE quarterly statistics on China's external assets/liabilities.
rics.how_to_use: China is a net external creditor (net IIP positive ~$3 trillion). Reserve assets ($3.2T) dominate external assets; FDI liabilities (~$3T) dominate liabilities. Net direct investment position has been deteriorating as outbound FDI slows and inbound FDI weakens.

rics.description: Foreign currency reserves
rics.meaning: Foreign Currency Reserves — FX-only component of total reserves (excludes gold, IMF position, SDRs). ~95% of total reserves.
rics.how_to_use: Currency composition: estimated ~60% USD, ~20% EUR, ~5% JPY, ~3% GBP, ~2% AUD, plus other (PBoC does not publish exact split). Diversification away from USD has been a slow multi-decade theme.

rics.description: Foreign currency reserves, % year on year, Standardized, Chg Y/Y
rics.meaning: China Foreign Exchange Operations: Foreign currency reserves, % year on year, Standardized, Chg Y/Y. SAFE-published data on FX market activity.
rics.how_to_use: Track SAFE's FX-purchase position and monthly FX settlement/sales by banks for understanding capital-flow direction. Persistent net FX sales by banks = capital outflow pressure.

rics.description: Official international reserves, Standardized
rics.meaning: Official International Reserves (Standardized) — China's total foreign reserves: FX, gold, IMF position, SDRs. The world's largest at ~$3.2 trillion. Published monthly by SAFE (State Administration of Foreign Exchange).
rics.how_to_use: THE critical CNY-defense indicator. Reserves peaked $4 trillion in 2014; fell to $3 trillion in 2017 during capital outflows; stabilized since at $3.0-3.3 trillion. Sharp drawdowns (>$50B/month) signal heavy FX intervention. SAFE publishes ~7th of each month.

rics.description: Reserves, Foreign currency reserves
rics.meaning: Foreign Currency Reserves — same as aCNFXMAA in alternative release. Tracks FX-only component.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against aCNFXMAA. FX reserves are the bulk of total reserves (~95%).

rics.description: Reserves, Gold
rics.meaning: Gold Reserves — China's gold holdings. PBoC has been a net gold buyer since 2022, increasing holdings from ~1,950 tons to ~2,250 tons (2024). Reflects strategic diversification away from USD reserves.
rics.how_to_use: Track PBoC gold purchases for de-dollarization signal. Monthly disclosures resumed post-2018 (PBoC was opaque about gold buys 2009-2015). Gold-price moves drive dollar-value swings; track ounces if available.

rics.description: Reserves, Total official reserve assets
rics.meaning: Total Official Reserve Assets — alternative release of total reserves. Companion to aCNCRESA.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against aCNCRESA. Total reserves include FX, gold, IMF position, SDRs.
